name: Charlie
source:
Always angry at being forced to share everything with her annoying sister, Charlie has a short fuse. She aches for the freedom of her own space.

At home, she will take every opportunity to be alone and have some fun - and she likes nothing more than to broadcast that private time over the internet to whoever is watching.

At school, Charlie reigns supreme with her sharp tongue and a wicked streak. But she often lashes out at those weaker and less fortunate than her.

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Charlie]DumbKoala[/url]]
